summary.text: John Leonard is a Democratic nominee for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 2A (2 seats), in the November 3, 2026 general election, alongside Brandon Thompson.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a construction estimator with 13 years in the industry.

paragraphs.text: John Leonard says in a Ballotpedia survey that he has worked as a construction estimator for 13 years.
He said his wife owns and operates a sustainability-focused flower farm where they live and are raising their son.
Leonard and Brandon Thompson advanced from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary for the district's two seats, with Leonard receiving 4,053 votes to Thompson's 4,050.
His stated campaign messages are affordability, support for community infrastructure such as parks and gathering places, and protection of voting, constitutional, digital and property rights.
He listed environment, public lands management, construction procurement, agriculture, digital rights and anti-corruption among his policy interests.
